tasks.short: Verify scoring calculations before winner announcement

steps.what: Match the compiled scores to the actual judges' or timing records and the applicable competition rules, checking entrants, rounds, penalties and unresolved inquiries.
outputs: verified scoring inputs and applicable rules

steps.what: Recompute scoring calculations and ranking checks in competition scoring software {OTHER}; configure native independent totals, penalty application and tie-rule checks, then inspect the calculation trace and any mismatch.
inputs: verified scoring inputs and applicable rules

steps.what: Resolve calculation discrepancies with the responsible officials, confirm all inquiries are dealt with under the rules and mark the completed verification outcome before any winner announcement.
Record the checked final score-verification outcome in competition scoring software {OTHER} before the separate announcement process.

tasks.design: Configure native arithmetic and tie-rule verification in competition scoring software {OTHER}. The official checks source scores and resolves disputes; no winner is announced by this design.
tasks.previous_blocker: Totals, penalties and tie calculations may be recomputed manually.
tasks.enabler_now: Explicit scoring rules support repeatable native arithmetic checks.
tasks.still_hard: Disputed judging inputs and unresolved inquiries require the responsible officials.
tasks.human_edge: Distinguish a correct sum from a competition result that is not yet valid to release.

ambition.what: No automatic winner announcement or artistic judgement.

tasks.altitude: Less repeated arithmetic; source verification and result responsibility remain.

reach.learn: Respect the distinction between provisional totals and cleared results.

evidence.claim: Competition scoring software can recompute explicit totals, penalties and tie rules without deciding disputed judging inputs.

assumptions: Boundary is calculation verification through its existing recorded outcome before announcement. Score compilation in task 3923 supplies an existing input here; its collection and entry are not counted again. Announcement is separate and earns no saving. Shares are scenarios.

Judges and timing staff produce actual entrant/event/round IDs, score values, penalties, status and source revision. Competition organisers supply the versioned aggregation and tie rules. The official checks these in s1; manual clarification is fully counted. Missing entries stop verification rather than defaulting to zero.

Try native independent calculation checks before code. Only manual arithmetic loses time. Current automated totals earn no runtime saving; if independent verification is already configured, savings are zero.

s3's ordinary final verification decision binds the completed outcome for s4's requested commit gate, with no extra self-approval stage. Changes require renewed checking. The one-share record action is fully retained.
research_questions: Can native verification expose the calculation trace separately from source-score disputes?

incremental.description: Maintain scoring and tie-rule versions and test examples.

approvals.approved_version: Final score-verification outcome checked at the end of s3

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Native checks remove 70% of the 35-hour recalculation share: 24.5 gross hours less 2 upkeep. Zero if already configured. Source checks, disputes and recording retain full time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Read the current race or competition start list and the applicable starting procedure, verifying the heat or event and any changes.
Check actual competitor positions and readiness, confirm timing and other officials are ready and judge whether conditions allow this race or competition to start.
Give the required live starting commands and start signal for the race or competition, responding to actual false-start or readiness problems under the applicable procedure.
outputs: actual competition start or recalled start

tasks.design: Keep the start with the official. The start-list lookup is separately examined; native list access does not replace checking actual readiness or giving the live signal.
tasks.previous_blocker: Starting depends on real-time readiness and judgement.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing start lists help identify the event but do not establish readiness.
tasks.still_hard: False starts and unexpected conditions need immediate human attention.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise when the scheduled start should be delayed or recalled.

reach.learn: Distinguish a scheduled start from the official's actual signal.

evidence.claim: A start list identifies scheduled competitors but does not determine their actual readiness.

assumptions: Boundary includes procedure and start-list lookup, actual readiness and the live start. Timing record maintenance and score compilation are distinct duties, not new administrative work attached to this task. No record or send required by this statement is hidden in a zero-saving conversation.

The existing organiser supplies event/heat IDs, entrants and list revision; the official verifies them in s1. Actual readiness comes from direct checks in s2. A scheduled time never proves the competition has started.

Native list access is assumed already adequate. No specific change shortens lookup, readiness assessment or live commands. There is no document commit or digital send and no invented approval activity.
No new configuration or upkeep is introduced, so incremental work is zero.
unknowns: Current starting procedure and list access
research_questions: Does any real repeated lookup remain beyond the current start list?

already_counted.description: Read and verify the actual event's start requirements.

incremental.description: No new process or software introduced.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Lookup is separated from readiness and live signalling. No specific change reduces any of these actions, so all time remains.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Collect the actual score sheets, timing records and approved event corrections, matching competitors, rounds and source status and resolving missing or unclear entries.
outputs: verified score and athletic source records

steps.what: Compile the score and athletic record entries in competition records software {OTHER}; configure native imports and event fields for structured timing and score records, retaining manual transcription of handwritten or unmatched sources.
inputs: verified score and athletic source records

steps.what: Check the completed compilation against source records in competition records software {OTHER}; use native missing-entry and duplicate flags, verify corrections and retain provisional status where needed.
inputs: verified score and athletic source records

steps.what: Save the checked final compiled score record in competition records software {OTHER} with its actual provisional or verified source status.

tasks.design: Configure native score imports and record checks in competition records software {OTHER}. The official verifies sources and the completed compilation; arithmetic verification before announcement remains the separate task 3916.
tasks.previous_blocker: Actual scores and timing entries may be copied into the event register by hand.
tasks.enabler_now: Native imports and explicit competitor and round identifiers can reduce repeated transcription.
tasks.still_hard: Handwritten corrections and mismatched competitor identifiers need human clarification.
tasks.human_edge: Preserve an uncertain or provisional entry instead of silently inventing a final result.

ambition.what: No automatic record certification or publication.

tasks.altitude: Less repeated transcription; responsibility for faithful source compilation remains.

reach.learn: Preserve source status and revisions in displayed results.

evidence.claim: Competition records tools can import structured score and timing entries and flag duplicates without validating a disputed score.

assumptions: Boundary is source collection and faithful record compilation through save. Live judging and timing are existing source-producing activities and earn no saving here. Calculation verification in task 3916 consumes this output rather than repeating compilation. Shares are scenarios.

Judges and timing staff produce event/round/competitor IDs, actual score or time, unit, penalties/corrections, provisional status and source version. The official checks completeness in s1; native imports map exact fields in s2. Paper sources, missing IDs and ambiguous corrections use counted manual entry and clarification. Missing scores are not zero.

Try native import and checks before code. Only repeated transcription and mechanical completeness checking lose time. Existing automatic timing runtime is not labour saving; already integrated records may save nothing.
s3's ordinary check of the complete compilation binds the requested s4 gate, with no extra approval stage. Edits require rechecking. Save retains its one-share time; no public send is introduced.
research_questions: Which actual score entries are still retyped from structured timing or judging records?

already_counted.description: Review imports, enter source exceptions and check final compilation.

incremental.description: Maintain score-field mappings and completeness checks.

approvals.approved_version: Final compiled score record checked at the end of s3

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Native import saves 30 hours and mechanical compilation checks 4.8, less 3 upkeep: 31.8 net. Zero if already integrated. Source clarification and save retain full time; arithmetic verification is not credited here.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Check the actual participant's identity and credentials against the event requirements, resolving inconsistent or missing evidence directly with the participant and authorised event staff.

Look up the matching registration, qualification and starting-order or handicap information in competition registration software {OTHER}; configure native participant filters and linked credential references, then verify the retrieved record and its validity.
Make the event's qualifying determination, starting-order decision or handicap determination under its actual rules, retaining exceptions and disputes for the authorised official process.
Write the actual credential check and qualifying determination in competition registration software {OTHER}, then check the completed entry against the participant evidence and the decision.
Save the checked final qualification entry in competition registration software {OTHER}.

tasks.design: Configure native participant filters and credential links in competition registration software {OTHER}. The official retains identity checks, qualifying decisions and the actual outcome entry.
tasks.previous_blocker: Matching participant records and finding current qualification information can require repeated navigation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native registration filters can locate explicit participant and event records.
tasks.still_hard: Identity discrepancies and unusual eligibility cases require the official's judgement.
tasks.human_edge: Avoid treating a matching name as proof of identity or a valid qualification.
tasks.altitude: Less registration lookup; qualifying responsibility remains unchanged.

reach.learn: Explain what evidence is missing without making an unsupported eligibility claim.

evidence.claim: Competition registration views can filter participant and qualification records without verifying physical identity.

assumptions: Boundary is credential verification and qualifying determination through its existing recorded outcome. Physical checking, actual decision and entry are all retained; no new participant report is added. Shares are scenarios.

The organiser maintains event and participant IDs, registration and credential references, validity dates and applicable rule version. The official verifies identity in s1 and the matched record in s2. Missing or conflicting evidence requires counted manual clarification. A name match does not establish eligibility.

Try native registration filters before code. Only repeated lookup loses time; physical evidence checks, qualification judgement and actual outcome writing do not. Existing automatic handicapping earns no new runtime saving.
The ordinary completed-entry check in s4 binds s5's requested commit gate without an additional approval activity. Changes require rechecking. Save retains one fully counted share.
research_questions: Can native filters expose current credential validity without silently matching ambiguous identities?

already_counted.description: Verify the retrieved registration and qualification information.

incremental.description: Maintain participant filters and credential links.

approvals.approved_version: Final qualification entry checked at the end of s4

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Native lookup removes 30% of the 20-hour registration lookup share: 6 gross hours less 1 upkeep. Zero if already configured. Physical credential checks, qualifying decisions, actual entry and save retain full time.

reach: Provide verified event status to broadcast announcers
